{"PythonCode":"import math

# Dimensions
plate_size = 140
cutout_size = 45
thickness = 10

# Calculate the position of the first plate (centered at origin)
plate1_x = -plate_size / 2
plate1_y = -plate_size / 2
plate1_z = 0

# Calculate the position of the second plate (rotated 90° around the z-axis)
plate2_x = -plate_size / 2
plate2_y = -plate_size / 2
plate2_z = 0

# Calculate the position of the cutout (centered on the first plate)
cutout_x = plate1_x + (plate_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y = plate1_y + (plate_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z = plate1_z

# Output the calculated positions
print({
    "plate1_x": plate1_x,
    "plate1_y": plate1_y,
    "plate1_z": plate1_z,
    "plate2_x": plate2_x,
    "plate2_y": plate2_y,
    "plate2_z": plate2_z,
    "cutout_x": cutout_x,
    "cutout_y": cutout_y,
    "cutout_z": cutout_z
})"}
